brief.objective: Design and implement a product-specific SaaS landing page that turns a complex workflow into a credible, scannable story.
brief.audience: A team lead evaluating whether a field-operations workspace fits an existing workflow.
brief.surface: Responsive marketing landing page for Northstar Relay, a fictional field-operations coordination product.
acceptance_criteria: The above-the-fold proposition, context, and primary action are immediately legible.
Sections follow a purposeful narrative: orientation, mechanism, workflow proof, objections, and next step.
Product-specific terminology and workflow evidence distinguish the page from a generic SaaS template.
Long copy, mobile navigation, form error, and reduced-motion states remain coherent.
No unsupported customer logos, metrics, testimonials, urgency, or capability claims appear as facts.

inputs.content: Northstar Relay: One calm workspace for the handoffs that keep field work moving. Use the terms route brief, handoff, proof of work, and offline note. Primary CTA: Start a workspace.

must_include: A mechanism section grounded in field-operations vocabulary
A truthful workflow or interface proof section without fabricated metrics
Objection handling, final CTA, useful footer navigation, and labeled placeholders when needed
must_avoid: Fake logos, customer quotes, numbers, certifications, or unsupported social proof
Hero illustration unrelated to field operations
Excessive pills, card soup, arbitrary gradients, decorative charts, or a changed product category
technology: Code-native copy and stateful form controls
accessibility: Use semantic landmarks and one logical page heading.
Test keyboard navigation, visible focus, form labels, error association, non-color cues, zoom/reflow, and reduced motion.
responsive: At 375px, menu, hero, CTA, proof, and form remain reachable without squeezed desktop columns.
At 768px, recompose at content breakpoints and avoid orphaned copy.
At 1440px, keep controlled reading measure and narrative rhythm.
constraints.notes: Exact product truth: Northstar Relay / One calm workspace for the handoffs that keep field work moving. Product specificity test: hide logo and judge whether field-operations vocabulary, workflow proof, data shape, and hierarchy still identify the product. Performance: specify image dimensions, responsive sources, lazy-loading policy, and font-display behavior. Edit when narrative/system is sound but one section, state, or responsive behavior has a localized gap; regenerate when the page remains generic or the product category is wrong. Stop at threshold, no material correction, budget exhaustion, tool block, or marginal improvement.

states.description: Complete page with truthful fixture content.
Mobile navigation opens, traps no focus accidentally, and preserves the primary path.
Keyboard focus is visible across navigation, CTA, and form controls.
Form error is local, associated, perceivable, and recoverable.
A realistic longer headline does not collapse hierarchy or CTA reachability.
Long supporting copy preserves measure and rhythm.
Reduced motion retains continuity and state meaning.

expected_artifacts.role: menu focus form-error and copy-stress interaction evidence
region and viewport visual regression ledger
applicable-dimension quality score with evidence confidence

immutable: Northstar Relay product category and supplied positioning
Primary CTA meaning and product vocabulary
high_sensitivity: Narrative order from orientation to conversion
Mobile CTA reachability and form recovery
flexible: Illustration medium, section arrangement within narrative, type pairing, palette, and surface treatment
forbidden_inference: Do not invent customers, logos, numbers, certifications, integrations, or legal claims.
Do not infer a visual identity from a generic SaaS trend.
